name: 97402 · Eugene, OR
findings: ZIP 97402 (Eugene) has 181 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97402 (Eugene) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97402 (Eugene) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
